#en: The residue scraped from incoming hulls carries more than dust; it carries direction. Tiny shards of scorched alloy and frozen vapor show trajectories no honest freighter should ever fly, angling away from charted lanes toward the same dark corner of the system again and again. Mixed wrong transponder pings, misheard dock calls, a few lazy corrections in the traffic logs turned it into background noise until someone bothered to line the fragments up.  \nSo far I have a dead outpost with an orphaned dataslate, conflicting reports from a frontier stop, and now physical proof that ships serving the same invisible route keep returning with the same graveyard clinging to their skin.
zh: 从进港船体上刮下的残留物承载的不只是灰尘；它承载着方向。被烧焦合金与冻结蒸气的细小碎片显示出任何诚实的货船都不该飞出的轨迹，一次次偏离已测绘航道，指向星系中同一个黑暗角落。\n错误应答器脉冲、听错的船坞呼叫、交通日志里几处懒惰的修正，把它混成了背景噪声，直到有人费心把这些碎片排齐。\n截至目前，我手里有一座带着孤儿数据板的死哨站、来自一处边境停靠点的矛盾报告，如今又有了实物证据：服务同一条看不见航线的船只，归来时总是黏着同一片墓场。

#en: The first anomaly has to be chased at its source, before it gets rewritten or buried under newer traffic. Whatever nudged those jumps off true left only a faint distortion in the timings, a tiny echo in the noise that will not survive another round of routine maintenance or quiet sabotage. Reading that echo clean means catching it early, while there is still enough context to tell a deliberate hand from a faulty buoy. So far all I have is this the same crooked drift showing up across different convoys, captains in frontier bars swearing unseen course corrections saved them, and a nervous analyst on Jemison watching entire anomaly folders vanish as soon as someone higher up took an interest.
zh:
第一处异常必须在源头就把住，趁它还没被改写或埋进更新的交通之下。
无论是谁把那些跃迁推离正轨，都只在时序里留下了微弱的畸变，一道不会挺过下一轮例行维护或悄然破坏的噪声小回声。
干净地读出这道回声，就意味着要趁早抓住它，趁上下文还足以分辨一只刻意的手与一座故障浮标。
截至目前，我手里的只有这些：不同运输队中出现同样的歪斜漂移、边境酒吧里船长们发誓是看不见的航向修正救了他们，以及杰米森星上一名紧张的分析员——只要上级有人表现出兴趣，整份异常文件夹就会消失。

#en: The marker is buried in corrupted telemetry and ghosted comms, a single recurring instruction threading through different battles and different ships, all pointing along the same forgotten curve in local space. When you strip away falsified headers and dead transponders, the path it outlines matches the movements of evacuated patients, blacked-out medical transports, and that medic who never stopped following his first set of orders.  \nWe first picked up his scent from an unremarkable cache on a lonely world, then from a gutted hull broadcasting scrambled commands, and finally from a silent UC frame with its logs carved clean, every step tightening the loop around his invisible triage line.
zh: 这标记埋在损坏的遥测与幽灵般的通讯里，一条反复出现的指令贯穿不同的战斗与不同的飞船，全都沿着本地空间中同一道被遗忘的曲线。\n当你剥去伪造的报头与死去的应答器，它勾出的路径与撤离病患的行动、失去信号的医疗运输船，以及那名从未停止执行自己最初命令的医护兵吻合。\n我们最早从一颗孤独世界上不起眼的藏匿点嗅到他的气息，随后是一具广播着乱码命令的被掏空船体，最后是一具日志被削得干干净净、沉默不语的联殖框架，每一步都收紧环绕他那条看不见的分诊线的环。

#en: Down there, the scars in the dirt feel honest. Heat-burned gullies, blasted rock, twin corridors carved over the same poor frontier roofs again and again until the land itself remembers the pattern. If I follow those tracks, I stay with the settlers and the Rangers, closer to the people who bled for someone's test flight. Maybe I learn who Stormline will spare, not just who he is willing to lose.\n\nUp here, in that junk ring, the sky is rigged like a loaded table. Old buoys whispering new numbers, ships nudged into invisible lanes while a Crimson Fleet hull waits to cash in on whoever survives the drop. If I go there first, I follow the money and the killers who bought his math, not the ghosts it left in the dust.
zh: 在下面，泥土里的伤疤显得诚实。被高温灼烧的沟壑、炸裂的岩石、一次次在同一片贫瘠边境屋顶上刻出的双走廊，直到大地本身都记住了这个图案。\n如果我循着那些痕迹追下去，我就会与定居者和游骑兵站在一起，更贴近那些为某人的试飞而流血的人。也许我能弄清"风暴线"会宽恕谁，而不只是他愿意牺牲谁。\n在上面，在那圈废料里，天空被布置得像一张做了手脚的赌桌。旧浮标低语着新数字，飞船被轻推进看不见的航道，而一具深红舰队船体正等着从坠落后幸存的人身上牟利。如果我先去那里，我追的就是钱和买下他那套算术的杀手，而非它留在尘土里的幽灵。

#en: Among the Fundrunner's sealed racks, one ledger stands out, its transfers looping through Deimos long after the ship was declared dead and its accounts supposedly settled. The dates match missing haulers, reassigned escorts, and those quiet inspection runs no one wanted to sign their name to, all terminating in the same scrapyard corridor. It does not name who rode those routes, but it draws a narrow corridor of opportunity, one that required someone with GalBank clearance and mercenary muscle to keep it open. So far the trail is a mislaid slate off the lanes, bad cargo math in Gagarin's bays, and an illicit route sketch from Neon's underside that all point toward the same habit of hiding people inside financial cleanups.
zh:
在资金快船密封的架列中，有一本账册格外醒目，它的转账在该船被宣告死亡、账户据称结清之后很久，仍绕经火卫二循环。
这些日期与失踪的运货船、被重新分配的护卫，以及那些没人愿意签名的安静巡查吻合，全都终止于同一条废料场走廊。
它没有点出是谁走了那些路线，却勾出一条狭窄的机会走廊——维持它需要某个拥有银河银行权限的人与佣兵的拳脚。
截至目前，这条线索是一块露出航道的错放石板、加加林星货舱里糟糕的货物计算，以及一份来自霓虹城底侧的非法路线草图，全都指向同一种习惯：把人藏进财务清理之中。

#en: The array's readings align too neatly with the broken hulls rusting in this yard; every twisted frame here shares the same slight skew in its last recorded jumps, the same quiet push off the official lanes toward some deeper gravity well. Pulling those numbers together at this place, where wreckage and recalculated vectors overlap, turns scattered anomalies into a map that finally points somewhere instead of nowhere. Up to now all I have had are a discarded log on a forgotten rock, convoy manifests that blame phantom malfunctions, a defector's story about stolen Fleet tech, and an orbital sensor hub humming on a frequency no one logs, each hinting that someone has been laying down a second set of paths beneath the Settled Systems.
zh: 阵列的读数与这座场区里生锈的破损船体对齐得过于整齐；这里每一具扭曲的框架，在它最后记录的跃迁中都有同样的轻微偏斜，同样悄然被推离官方航道、驶向某个更深的重力井。\n在这残骸与重算向量重叠的地方把这些数字汇拢，便把零散的异常变成一张终于指向某处而非无从所往的地图。\n迄今为止，我手里的只有一块被遗忘岩石上被丢弃的日志、把故障归咎于幽灵的运输队舱单、一名变节者关于失窃舰队科技的说法，以及一座以无人记录的频率嗡鸣的轨道传感器枢纽，每一处都暗示有人在定居星系之下铺设了第二套路径。

#en: The lattice spills across the Navy console like a spiderweb of sanctioned lies, jump vectors bent carefully around charted lanes to converge on the same blank patch of space every time. Only a warship of this size would be allowed to store an unauthorized route so close to patrol data without triggering audits, which is why whoever plotted it hid behind military encryption and kept their commentary to terse, bloodless notation. Cross-referenced with the stray slate from the backwater shack, the corrupted logs from that drifting hauler, and the pathing anomalies pulled off civilian manifests, the pattern is no longer rumor; it is a repeatable corridor leading away from every accident site and dead transmission you have touched so far.
zh: 格栅像一张由获批谎言织成的蛛网铺满海军控制台，跃迁向量被小心翼翼地绕过已测绘航道弯折，每次都汇聚到同一片空白空域。\n只有这个体量的军舰才被允许在巡逻数据如此近处存放一条未授权路线而不触发审计，正因如此，绘制它的人藏在军用加密之后，把自己的注释压成简短、冷酷的符号。\n与来自穷乡小屋的散落石板、那艘漂流运货船的损坏日志，以及从民用舱单上提取的航路异常交叉比对，这图案不再是传言；它是一条可复现的走廊，背离你迄今触碰过的每一处事故现场与死去的传输。

#en: When the container breaches and the last trace of strange radiation flares against the bunker's old sensors, the system reacts like it has seen this pattern before, quietly flagging a destination it was never meant to reveal. In the afterglow, a buried routine awakens in the base's cracked consoles, spitting out archived handoff logs, medical transport requests, and encrypted route hashes all pointing to the same orbital facility that has been patching up grav-burned crews for decades. So far the trail runs from a nameless rock with a corrupted slate, to falsified cargo records aboard a wandering hauler, and now to a war-era bunker whose own alarms whisper the same name the healers in Deepala's shadow have been muttering off the record.
zh: 当容器破裂、最后一丝古怪辐射在碉堡老旧传感器上闪起时，系统仿佛见过这种图案般作出反应，悄然标出一个它本不该揭示的目的地。\n在余晖中，一段被掩埋的例程在基地龟裂的控制台里苏醒，吐出存档的交接日志、医疗运输请求与加密航路哈希，全都指向同一座几十年来一直修补被重力灼伤船员的轨道设施。\n截至目前，这条线索从一块带着损坏石板的无名岩石，到一艘游荡运货船上伪造的货运记录，如今又来到一座战时代的碉堡——它自己的警报低语着迪帕拉阴影中的医者们一直在私下念叨的同一个名字。

#en: The relay bunker still hums like it is waiting for orders that never came, walls sweating old condensate under dead status lights. Whatever was siphoned out of those wrecked hulls and stored here links the scrap fields to the patrol grid, a chemical fingerprint that should never have been in UC airspace at all. Matching that residue against atmospheric sweeps will show exactly which vector carried it in and out, and no patrol captain can hand wave away that kind of overlap as "sensor drift." So far the trail runs from a forgotten cache on a backwater rock, to a gutted Deimos yard, and now into this abandoned nerve node, each step tightening the circle around one pilot who keeps treating battlefields like they are still his personal worksite.
zh:
中继碉堡仍在嗡鸣，像在等候从未到来的命令，墙壁在死去的状态灯下渗着陈年冷凝水。
无论从那些损毁船体中抽取、储存在这里的是什么，都把废料场与巡逻网格连在一起，是一枚本不该出现在联殖空域中的化学指纹。
把这残留与大气扫描比对，就能显示究竟是哪条向量把它带进带出，而没有哪位巡逻舰长能把这种重合一挥手说成"传感器漂移"。
截至目前，这条线索从一块穷乡岩石上一处被遗忘的藏匿点，到一座被掏空的火卫二船坞，如今又深入这个被遗弃的神经节点，每一步都收紧圆圈，围绕一名始终把战场当作自己私人工作场地的飞行员。

#en: In the noise of Gagarin Landing's traffic streams, the vector stands out like a bad weld someone tried to grind flat and forgot about. Crosschecked against yard shift changes and tug launch times, it reveals a repeating burn that always arcs toward the same patch of dead space, threaded neatly between SysDef patrol windows and corporate shipping lanes. It is not a smuggler's improvisation but a worker's route, laid in pieces by different hands and never meant to be read as one line. So far the chase has scraped a half erased log from a forgotten rock, shipbreaker markings in a gutted yard, buried sensor echoes in an old relay, and a hijacked service feed here in the slums all converging on the same unseen graveyard he still treats like home.
zh:
在加加林着陆点交通流的噪声中，这条向量像一处有人试图磨平却忘了的糟糕焊缝一样醒目。
与船坞班次变化和拖船出港时刻交叉核对，它揭示出一次反复出现的点火，总是弯向同一片死寂空域，整齐地穿在联殖防务巡逻窗口与企业航运航道之间。
它不是走私贩的临场发挥，而是工人的路线，由不同的手一块块铺设，从未打算被当作一条线来读。
截至目前，这场追查已刮出一块被遗忘岩石上一条半被抹除的日志、一座被掏空船坞里的拆船工标记、一座旧中继站里被埋藏的传感器回声，以及贫民区这里一条被劫持的服务馈送，全都汇聚到他仍视作家的同一片看不见的墓场。

#en: Ebbside means people, and people mean mouths that slip when the drinks are strong and the credits are late. If I shake down the right freight clerk or warehouse runner, I might finally put faces and factions to the payments buying her storms. Of course, walking those alleys with her name on my lips risks stirring up everyone who thought they were just paying for "expedited deliveries," not rewriting their skies.\n\nThe orbital node is quieter, less blood and more numbers. If I pull the raw readings from that relic, I could see the full arc of her work in one sweep, every world her corrections keep bending toward. No bribes, no threats, just me, a data core, and whatever failsafes she left behind in an automated system nobody has watched for years.
zh:
埃布赛德意味着人，而人意味着在酒够烈、钱又拖欠时管不住的嘴。
如果我敲打对了货运文书或仓库跑腿，也许终于能给那些出钱买她风暴的人对上脸和派系。
当然，揣着她的名字走过那些小巷，风险是惊动每一个本以为只是在为"加急配送"付钱、而非在改写自己天空的人。

轨道节点更安静，流血更少、数字更多。如果我从那件遗物中取出原始读数，就能一眼看到她那套工作的完整弧线，看到她每一次修正都在弯向的每一颗世界。没有贿赂、没有威胁，只有我、一个数据核心，以及她留在某个多年无人看管的自动化系统里的全部失效保护。

#en: The old relay hangs in a graveyard of abandoned signals, its dishes frozen mid-gesture toward lanes no one charts anymore. If his routes were ever scrubbed from official records, this is where the echoes would have lodged, half-corrupted in buffer stacks and forgotten diagnostic logs. Out here there are no clerks to massage the numbers, no captains to rewrite after-action reports, just raw jump scars burned into hardware and left to rot. So far the hunt has turned up a nameless cache of navigation data on a forgotten rock and stories of a transport that "teleported wrong" near the frontier; whatever is hiding in this dead node will either tie those fragments together or prove that someone has been bending the map for far longer than anyone wants to admit.
zh:
这座旧中继站悬在一片被遗弃信号的墓场中，它的天线停在指向无人测绘航道的姿态中。
如果他的路线曾被从官方记录中擦净，回声就会滞留在这里，半被损坏地卡在缓冲堆栈与被遗忘的诊断日志里。
在这外面没有文书去揉捏数字，没有舰长去改写战报，只有烙进硬件、任其腐朽的生跃迁伤疤。
截至目前，这场追查已挖出一块被遗忘岩石上一处无名的导航数据藏匿点，以及关于一艘运输船在边境附近"跃迁出错"的传闻；这个死节点里藏着的东西，要么会把这些碎片串起来，要么会证明有人弯折这张地图的时间远比任何人愿意承认的更久。
